headline: Copper Falls 1% and Hits One-Year Low as AI Rally Runs Out of Steam
summary: Copper prices extended losses to hit their lowest level in almost a year on Wednesday. Selling pressure returned as the rally in artificial intelligence-related assets faded.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in electrical wiring and grid infrastructure, so its prices are watched as a gauge of industrial demand.
why_moved: Selling pressure returned after the AI-related asset rally faded, pushing copper to a near one-year low.
original_headline: El cobre cae 1% y toca mínimo de un año ante al agotamiento del repunte de la IA
